appraisal_events.evidence: j'avais compté sans le revers qu'avait la gentille admiration de Robert pour moi ... il avait oublié que ces idées n'étaient pas de lui ... crut devoir me souhaiter la bienvenue avec chaleur et m'approuver
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's retrospective commentary gently exposes Saint-Loup's admiration as so total and indiscriminate that he unconsciously absorbs the narrator's own ideas and ends up warmly 'welcoming' the narrator to what was in fact the narrator's own thought, as though the narrator were trespassing on Saint-Loup's intellectual territory.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup is mildly and affectionately diminished by the narrator's ironic exposure of his uncritical, forgetful absorption of others' ideas as his own.
